title: How to Apply for Passport Online - Fresh, Renewal, Tatkal - Complete Guide
meta_description: Passport application 2026 - online apply via Passport Seva portal, fresh application, renewal, tatkal urgent, documents, fees ₹1,500-4,000, police verification.

hero.one_liner: Apply for Indian passport online through Passport Seva portal - normal processing 30 days, Tatkal (urgent) in 1-3 days for travel emergencies

sections.heading: Understanding Passport Types & Processing
content: FRESH PASSPORT (first-time applicant): - For: Anyone getting a passport for the first time OR whose passport expired more than 3 years ago - Fee: ₹1,500 (36-page booklet) or ₹2,000 (60-page booklet for frequent travelers) - Processing: 30-45 working days AFTER police verification - Police verification required: Yes (officer visits your address) - Timeline breakdown: Online application → Document verification (2-5 days) → Police verification (5-15 days) → Printing (5-10 days) → Speed Post delivery (2-5 days) PASSPORT RENEWAL: - For: Passport expiring within 1 year OR expired less than 3 years ago - Fee: ₹1,500 (same as fresh) - Processing: 7-15 working days (MUCH faster than fresh) - Police verification: May be SKIPPED if address hasn't changed (big advantage) - Best feature: No police visit if same address - almost automatic renewal TATKAL (URGENT): - For: Travel emergencies - someone gets a job offer with 1-week joining deadline, or flight ticket already booked, etc.

- Fee: ₹3,500 (36-page) or ₹4,000 (60-page) - Processing: 1-3 working days from appointment date - Requirement: Must provide additional identity proof from authorized list (college ID from recognized institution, school certificate, employment letter from recognized employer, certificate from gazetted officer) - No police verification typical, but biometric capture required MINOR PASSPORT (below 18): - Fee: ₹1,000 (valid for 5 years or until age 18, whichever comes first) - Processing: 30 days - Special requirement: Both parents' consent mandatory OR single parent affidavit (if one parent deceased or unknown) - At age 18, can apply for adult passport

sections.caption: The entire passport application is online at passportindia.gov.in. You visit the PSK (Passport Seva Kendra) only once for document verification and biometrics. Normal processing: 15-30 days. Tatkal: 1-3 days.

sections.heading: Step 1: Register & Apply Online on Passport Seva

steps.title: Visit passportindia.gov.in - Passport Seva Portal
steps.description: Go to official Ministry of External Affairs passport portal. First-time users: Click 'Register' to create account with email and password. Existing users: Click 'Login'.

steps.title: Click 'Apply for Fresh Passport' or 'Re-issue of Passport'
steps.description: Choose: (1) Fresh Passport → for first-time applicants, (2) Re-issue of Passport → for renewal or changes to existing passport. Each has its own form.

steps.title: Select Normal or Tatkal processing
steps.description: Fresh Passport: Choose Normal (30 days, ₹1,500) or Tatkal (1-3 days, ₹3,500). Renewal: Can also choose Normal or Tatkal (Tatkal renewal less common but available for urgent travel).

steps.title: Select 36-page or 60-page booklet
steps.description: 36-page: Standard, cheaper, sufficient for most people (valid 10 years, approximately 32-page capacity for visa stamps). 60-page: For frequent travelers, more visa space. Difference: ₹500 (36-page ₹1,500 vs 60-page ₹2,000).

steps.title: Fill online application form
steps.description: Very detailed form - takes 30-45 minutes. Enter: Full name (as on Aadhaar), date of birth, gender, parents' names (father + mother), present address, permanent address (if different), occupation, educational qualification, emergency contact, mother tongue, previous passport details (if any).

steps.title: Answer security questions about your address history
steps.description: The form asks: Where did you live in the last 1-3 years? Any frequent address changes trigger additional verification. Be accurate - lies here can lead to police investigation.

steps.title: Select Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) nearest to you
steps.description: Choose: Passport Seva Kendra (PSK) = dedicated passport center, OR Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK) = passport services at select post offices. Both process identically. Choose whichever is nearest to your location.

steps.title: Upload photo and signature
steps.description: Photo: Recent color photo, 2x2 inch, white background, full-face visible, JPEG format, 10KB-300KB size. CRITICAL: Photo should match specification exactly - wrong photo is the most common rejection reason. Signature: Sign on white paper, scan/photograph, upload as JPEG, 10KB-300KB. Ensure signature is clearly visible (not too light).

steps.title: Upload identity and address documents (PDF/JPEG, max 500KB each)
steps.description: Identity proof: Aadhaar card (best), Voter ID, Driving License, or PAN card - scan both sides. Address proof: Aadhaar (best), Utility bill (within 3 months), Bank statement, Passport, Voter ID. Date of birth proof: Birth certificate (for births after 26/01/1989, this is MANDATORY), 10th marksheet, Aadhaar, Passport. Scan all documents clearly - blurry scans cause rejection.

steps.title: Upload guardianship documents (if applicable)
steps.description: For minors: Birth certificate is mandatory. Parental consent letter (letter from parents confirming they consent to passport, on plain paper, signed by both). Marriage certificate (if married and name changed). Divorce decree (if previously divorced and name reverted).

steps.title: Review all information before submission
steps.description: CRITICAL STEP: Review all details carefully. Name, DOB, parents' names, address - all must match uploaded documents exactly. Mismatches cause rejections. Recheck 2-3 times before proceeding.

steps.title: Pay fee online
steps.description: Fees: Fresh 36-page: ₹1,500, Fresh 60-page: ₹2,000, Renewal 36-page: ₹1,500, Renewal 60-page: ₹2,000, Tatkal 36-page: ₹3,500, Tatkal 60-page: ₹4,000. Pay via: Net banking (all banks), Debit card, Credit card, or SBI Challan (if preferred, pay at bank and upload receipt). Online payment is instant and gives you receipt immediately.

steps.title: Download application receipt
steps.description: After payment, system generates 'Application Reference Number' (ARN) and allows download of application receipt (PDF). SAVE THIS RECEIPT - you'll need to show it at PSK appointment.

steps.title: Book appointment at Passport Seva Kendra (PSK)
steps.description: After online payment, book appointment for your nearest PSK. Calendar shows available dates and time slots. For Tatkal: book 1-3 days ahead (some PSKs allow same-day). For Normal: book 7-14 days ahead. Choose convenient date and time - appointment confirmation sent via email and SMS.

steps.title: Prepare documents for PSK visit
steps.description: Bring: (1) Application receipt (printed), (2) Original Aadhaar + color photocopy, (3) Original address proof + photocopy (utility bill/bank statement), (4) Birth certificate (original), (5) For minors: original parental consent letter, (6) For name change: marriage certificate or deed poll, (7) Appointment confirmation (printed or on mobile), (8) Any other original documents uploaded.

steps.title: Visit PSK on appointment date
steps.description: Reach 10 minutes early (appointments are strict, arriving late may cancel slot). Carry all documents. PSK process: (1) Token number issued, (2) Counter A: Document verification and cross-checking with uploaded scans, (3) Counter B: Biometric capture - photo taken at PSK (overwriting uploaded photo), fingerprints (all 10 fingers), and signature captured on tablet, (4) Counter C: Final verification and confirmation. Total time at PSK: 1-3 hours.

steps.title: No need for police interview at PSK
steps.description: Police verification happens AFTER you leave PSK (for fresh passports). You don't interact with police at PSK. Police verification is done at your home address afterward (officer visits, sometimes both times or just once).

steps.title: Police verification for fresh passport applicants
steps.description: After your PSK visit, the MEA sends your case to local police for verification. A police officer visits your address mentioned in application. They verify: (1) You actually live at that address, (2) Neighbors/landlord confirm your residence, (3) Your background (no criminal record). This takes 5-15 days. Sometimes officer calls you instead of visiting.

steps.title: If police verification fails
steps.description: Usually happens if: (1) You listed wrong address, (2) You're not present when officer visits (ask to reschedule), (3) Neighbors deny knowing you (common in large apartments). Contact your local police station to clarify. If address is correct and you're cooperative, it ALWAYS passes eventually - just may take additional time.

steps.title: Passport printing
steps.description: After police verification approval, your passport is printed. This takes 5-10 days from verification clearance.

steps.title: Delivery via Speed Post
steps.description: Printed passport is dispatched via India Post Speed Post to your registered address (the address in your application). Delivery takes 2-5 days depending on location. Track delivery at indiapost.gov.in or the tracking number provided via SMS.

steps.title: Receive passport at home
steps.description: Passport arrives in a sealed envelope. You sign receipt. Passport is now valid for: 10 years (for adults), 5 years (for minors). Check validity date inside the booklet.

sections.heading: Tatkal Passport - When & How to Use
content: When to Use Tatkal?

(1) Got job offer with 1-week joining date and need visa (2) Flight ticket already booked for urgent travel (3) Medical emergency requiring immediate international travel (4) Family emergency (death, critical illness in family overseas) Tatkal Requirements: - Higher fee (₹3,500 vs ₹1,500) - ADDITIONAL identity proof from authorized list: School/College certificate from recognized institution, OR employment letter from recognized employer, OR Certificate from Gazetted Officer (government officer) - get letter on official letterhead confirming your identity - Fast-track appointment (book 1-3 days ahead instead of 7-14) - Processing: PSK visit + biometrics → Police verification SAME DAY or next day → Passport printing in 1-2 days → Delivery in 1-3 days = Total 1-7 days How to Apply Tatkal: Process is SAME as normal fresh/renewal.

Just: (1) Select 'Tatkal' instead of 'Normal' during online application, (2) Provide additional identity proof (gazetted officer letter, school/college certificate, employment letter), (3) Pay higher fee (₹3,500), (4) Book appointment for earlier dates.

Tatkal Limitations:
- No police verification in true sense - Tatkal is based on trust and urgency
- Must provide additional strong identity proof
- Available only at major PSKs (not all centers offer Tatkal)
- Check passportindia.gov.in for which PSKs offer Tatkal in your city

sections.heading: Common Mistakes to Avoid
rows: Photo doesn't match specification (wrong size, color, background)
Rejection - application sent back, fee not refunded
Follow exact photo specs: 2x2 inch, white background, color, 10-300KB JPEG. Use professional passport photo studio (₹100-300).
Name mismatch between application and documents
Ensure name is EXACTLY same in all documents. If names differ (nickname vs full name), attach affidavit explaining.
Police verification fails or is suspicious
List the address where you've lived longest in last 1-3 years. If new to an address, update address in application to place you've lived longer.
Submitting blurry or incomplete document scans
Scan documents on good quality scanner or use phone app like CamScanner. Ensure all 4 corners of document visible, text clear.
Not providing birth certificate for adults born after 1989
If applying for first passport born after 26/01/1989, birth certificate is NON-NEGOTIABLE. Get it from municipal office first if don't have.
Applying with expired/renewed Aadhaar before update
Ensure Aadhaar is up-to-date. If recently renewed, wait for digital update before applying.
Wrong PSK selection - far from home
Choose PSK nearest to your home or workplace. Check exact location and hours before booking appointment.

sections.heading: Passport Validity & Renewal Timeline
rows: Within 1 year before expiry; or up to 3 years after expiry
At age 18: must apply for adult passport
No additional renewal needed for just name/address changes

sections.heading: Types of passport and which one you need
content: Ordinary Passport (P-type, navy blue cover): This is what 99% of Indians apply for. Valid for 10 years for adults (18+) and 5 years for minors (under 18).

Used for personal travel - tourism, business visits, education abroad, medical treatment, and employment overseas. 36 pages (standard) or 60 pages (jumbo - for frequent travelers). The 36-page version is sufficient for most people.

Diplomatic Passport (D-type, maroon cover): Issued to Indian diplomats, IFS officers, and senior government officials posted abroad. You can't apply for this - it's issued by the Ministry of External Affairs to eligible government servants.
If you're an IAS/IFS officer, your cadre controlling authority arranges this.

Official Passport (S-type, white cover): For government employees traveling abroad on official duty. Arranged by the sponsoring government department - you don't apply individually. If your department sends you for international training or conference, they process the official passport.

Emergency Certificate (EC): A single-journey travel document issued by Indian embassies abroad to Indian citizens who lose their passport while traveling. Valid for one return trip to India only. Not applied for from India - issued at embassies in emergency situations.

sections.heading: How to apply for passport online - complete walkthrough
content: Step 1 - Register on Passport Seva portal: Visit passportindia.gov.in → New User Registration. Enter name, date of birth, email, and create a login ID and password.

Verify email through the activation link sent to your inbox. This portal is the ONLY legitimate online passport application system - don't use third-party websites or apps that charge 'processing fees.'

Step 2 - Fill the application form: Log in → Apply for Fresh Passport/Re-issue → Fill the online form. The form has sections: Personal Details (name as per Aadhaar, DOB, gender, marital status), Family Details (father, mother, spouse names), Present Address (must match your Aadhaar/address proof), Emergency Contact, and Other Details (criminal cases, if any).
Save the form frequently - the session times out after 15 minutes of inactivity.

Step 3 - Pay fees and book appointment: After submitting the form, pay the passport fee online - Rs 1,500 for normal 36-page passport (adults), Rs 2,000 for normal 60-page, Rs 3,500 for Tatkal 36-page. Payment via net banking, credit/debit card, or UPI.
After payment, book an appointment at your nearest PSK (Passport Seva Kendra) or POPSK (Post Office Passport Seva Kendra). Choose a date and time slot that's convenient.
Step 4 - Visit PSK on appointment date: Reach 15 minutes early. Carry: printed application receipt, original documents + 1 photocopy of each, and the appointment confirmation.

At the PSK, you go through 3 counters: Counter A (document verification - officer checks your originals), Counter B (biometrics - photo, fingerprints, and digital signature capture), Counter C (final verification and submission). Total time at PSK: 1-3 hours depending on crowd.

Step 5 - Police verification and delivery: After PSK visit, your application is forwarded to the local police station for address and identity verification. The police officer visits your home or calls you to the police station within 7-15 days.
After police clearance, the passport is printed at Central Passport Printing Facility and dispatched via Speed Post. Delivery: 15-30 days after PSK visit for normal, 1-3 days for Tatkal.

sections.heading: Documents required - the definitive checklist
content: Proof of present address (any ONE): Aadhaar card (most commonly accepted - recommended), water/electricity/gas bill (in applicant's or parent's/spouse's name, recent 3 months), Voter ID, bank passbook/statement with address (recent 3 months), income tax assessment order, or rent agreement with latest utility bill. Aadhaar is the easiest - if your Aadhaar address is current, it alone suffices for address proof.

Proof of date of birth (any ONE): Birth certificate (issued by Municipal Corporation or Gram Panchayat), 10th class marksheet/certificate from recognized board, Aadhaar card (if DOB is printed on it), PAN card, or Voter ID. For adults, the 10th marksheet is the most common and universally accepted DOB proof.
For minors (under 18): Birth certificate is mandatory. One parent's passport copy (if available).
Annexure D (consent of both parents) - both parents must sign. If only one parent is applying for the minor's passport, Annexure C (consent of the other parent) or court order is needed.
School bonafide letter confirming the child's name and DOB.
Special situations: Name changed after marriage - marriage certificate + spouse's passport copy. Divorced - divorce decree from court.
Government employee - NOC from employer (Annexure B). Criminal case pending - court permission letter.
Address different from Aadhaar - update Aadhaar first (easiest option) or carry 2 separate address proofs showing different addresses with dates.

sections.heading: Normal vs Tatkal passport - when to use which
content: Normal passport: Rs 1,500 fee, 15-30 days processing time after PSK visit. Police verification happens BEFORE passport issuance. This is the standard process - use this if you're applying well in advance of your travel date. Plan at least 45 days from application to passport in hand.

Tatkal passport: Rs 3,500 fee (Rs 2,000 extra over normal), 1-3 days processing after PSK visit. Police verification happens AFTER passport issuance - you get the passport first, police verification is done later.
Use Tatkal only for genuine emergencies - medical emergency abroad, sudden job opportunity, family emergency, etc.

Tatkal requires additional documents: Annexure F (verification certificate from a gazetted officer, MP, MLA, or head of recognized institution like school principal, college dean). This certificate confirms your identity and address.
Without Annexure F, Tatkal application is rejected. Get this certificate BEFORE visiting the PSK - it takes time to locate a gazetted officer willing to sign.
Is Tatkal worth the extra Rs 2,000? Only if you genuinely need the passport within 3-7 days.

If your travel is 3+ weeks away, normal processing is sufficient. Many agents and touts push Tatkal unnecessarily to charge extra 'facilitation fees.' Don't fall for it - the normal process works perfectly for planned travel.

sections.heading: Police verification - what happens and how to prepare
content: After your PSK visit, the passport office sends a verification request to the police station in your area. A police officer (typically an ASI or Head Constable) visits your home to verify: Do you actually live at the address you provided?
Can your neighbors/landlord confirm your identity? Are there any criminal cases against you?

What to prepare: Keep a photocopy of your passport application receipt, rent agreement (if living in rented accommodation), and landlord's phone number (the police officer may call the landlord for confirmation). Inform your neighbors that a police officer might ask about you - neighbors who confirm your identity speed up the verification.
Timing: Police verification typically happens 7-15 days after PSK visit for normal applications. For Tatkal, verification is post-issuance (within 30 days of passport receipt).
If the police officer hasn't visited after 15 days, visit your local police station with the application reference number and ask about the status.

Common issues: Police officer not finding you at home (they visit during working hours when you're at office - leave your phone number and request a call before visit). Address mismatch between application and actual residence (ensure your application address is exactly where you live - apartment number, building name, locality must match).
Criminal record flag (if you have a pending case, the police verification will be delayed and may require court clearance - submit this proactively to avoid multi-month delays).

sections.caption: Steps to follow

sections.heading: Passport renewal and re-issue
content: Renewal (before expiry): Apply online at passportindia.gov.in → Re-issue of Passport. Select reason: 'Validity expired within 3 years / about to expire.' The process is identical to fresh application - online form, fee payment, PSK appointment, biometrics.
Fee: Rs 1,500 for normal, Rs 3,500 for Tatkal. Police verification may be waived if your address hasn't changed and your current passport was issued after 2013.

Re-issue for damaged/lost passport: If your passport is damaged (torn pages, water damage, unreadable) or lost/stolen, apply for re-issue. For lost passport: file an FIR at the police station first, then apply online with the FIR copy.
For damaged: carry the damaged passport to the PSK. Fee is the same as fresh application.
Police verification is mandatory for lost passport re-issue.

Name change in passport: If you've changed your name (marriage, court-ordered name change, or gender change), apply for re-issue with name change. Submit: marriage certificate (for name change due to marriage), Gazette notification or court order (for other name changes), and old passport.
The new passport will have an observation page noting the previous name.

Address change: If you've moved to a new city, apply for re-issue with address change. The new passport will reflect your updated address. Police verification will be conducted at the NEW address. If both old and new addresses are in the same police jurisdiction, verification is faster.

sections.heading: POPSK - Post Office Passport Seva Kendra
content: POPSKs are passport service centers located inside post offices - bringing passport services to smaller cities and towns that don't have a full Passport Seva Kendra. Over 600 POPSKs operate across India, making passport application accessible even in tehsil-level towns.

The application process at POPSK is identical to PSK - online application, fee payment, appointment booking, document verification, and biometrics. The only difference is location - POPSKs are inside post offices, so the environment feels less formal than a dedicated PSK.

POPSK advantage: Shorter queues (fewer applicants than city PSKs), closer to home for small-town residents (no need to travel to the nearest city with a PSK), and friendly service (post office staff are generally more approachable than PSK contract staff). Disadvantage: some POPSKs have limited working hours (only 2-3 days per week) and limited appointment slots.

Find your nearest POPSK: On passportindia.gov.in → Locate Passport Seva Centre → Select your state and district → Both PSKs and POPSKs in your area are listed with address, contact number, and working days. If a POPSK is closer to you than the nearest PSK, book your appointment there - the service quality and processing time are identical.
Check the POPSK working schedule before visiting - some operate only 3 days per week. Call the post office to confirm the POPSK counter is active on your intended visit date.

sections.heading: Common passport mistakes and how to avoid them
content: Mistake 1: Name in application doesn't match Aadhaar/10th marksheet exactly. If your Aadhaar says 'Rajesh Kumar' but your 10th marksheet says 'Rajesh Kumar Singh,' the PSK officer flags a discrepancy.
Ensure your name is IDENTICAL across all documents before applying. If there's a mismatch, get one of them corrected first - Aadhaar correction is fastest (7-15 days at myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in).
Mistake 2: Applying with incorrect address. Your passport address must be where you actually live - not your hometown address.
If you live in Noida but apply with your Lucknow hometown address, the police verification will be sent to Lucknow. You'll need to travel to Lucknow for verification or the verification will fail.
Apply with your current residential address.
Mistake 3: Not carrying original documents to PSK. The PSK requires ORIGINAL documents - not photocopies, not DigiLocker screenshots.
Carry every document in original plus one photocopy. Forgot your original 10th marksheet?
Your application will be held until you submit it. Don't waste a PSK appointment by forgetting documents.
Mistake 4: Using agents or touts. Passport application at passportindia.gov.in is entirely self-service.

No agent or tout can speed up your application - they simply fill the online form (which you can do yourself) and charge Rs 2,000-5,000 for it. Some agents also submit Tatkal applications unnecessarily (charging you Rs 2,000 extra fee + their commission).
Apply yourself - it takes 30 minutes online.

sections.heading: Official Sources & References
sections.content: Source: Ministry of External Affairs, Passport Seva (passportindia.gov.in). All information on this page has been verified against official government notifications and regulatory circulars. For the latest updates, always check the official portal.

sections.heading: Use POPSK instead of PSK - shorter queues, same service
sections.content: If your nearest PSK has appointment slots booked for weeks, check POPSKs (Post Office Passport Seva Kendras) in your district. There are 600+ POPSKs across India - many in smaller towns with much shorter waiting times. The service, processing time, and passport quality are identical. Book at passportindia.gov.in → Locate Passport Seva Centre → filter by your district.

sections.heading: Don't use third-party websites or agents
sections.content: passportindia.gov.in is the ONLY legitimate passport application portal. Websites like 'passport-online.in,' 'epassport-india.com,' or similar domains are SCAMS - they charge Rs 1,000-5,000 for simply filling the form that you can fill yourself for free. Never share your personal details on any website other than passportindia.gov.in. If someone calls offering 'fast passport processing,' it's a tout - hang up.

sections.text: 14 crore Indian passports are in circulation - but 90 crore+ Indians still don't have one. The passport application process takes 30 minutes online and one PSK visit. Total cost: Rs 1,500. If you have any future plans involving international travel - for work, education, medical treatment, or even just the option to travel - apply now. A passport in hand opens doors that you can't predict today.

faqs.question: How long does passport actually take to arrive?
faqs.answer: Normal: 30-45 days total (including police verification and delivery). Tatkal: 1-7 days. Renewal: 7-15 days. After passport is dispatched by Speed Post, allow 2-5 days for postal delivery depending on your location. Track delivery on indiapost.gov.in.

faqs.question: Can I apply for passport without Aadhaar?
faqs.answer: Aadhaar is not technically mandatory, but it SIGNIFICANTLY speeds up verification. Without Aadhaar, you need multiple alternative documents (passport, voter ID, driving license) and police verification takes much longer. With Aadhaar, biometric verification is electronic - faster. Highly recommended to have Aadhaar before applying.

faqs.question: Police verification failed. What now?
faqs.answer: Usually fails due to: wrong address, not being home when officer visits, or neighbors denying your residence. Contact your local police station and explain. Request officer to visit again at a convenient time. If address was wrong, you may need to re-apply (though some PSKs allow address change). Being cooperative with police - they ALWAYS clear you eventually.

faqs.question: I have two passports (lost old one, got new one, found old). Is this legal?
faqs.answer: NO. One person = one valid passport. Having two is illegal. If you have old and new valid passports: (1) Surrendered the old one during renewal? It's not valid anymore. (2) Found your old one? Surrender it to PSK immediately. (3) Both still valid? Contact MEA and clarify - one will be cancelled.

faqs.question: Can I get a second passport for business travel (visa already in first)?
faqs.answer: YES, under specific conditions: (1) Your first passport's visa pages are nearly full (you've collected too many stamps) and won't have space for more, (2) You frequently travel and need to submit passport to embassies while possessing another passport. MEA allows 'Simultaneous Passports' in such cases. You must apply in writing with valid reason.

faqs.question: Passport for newborn baby - how to apply?
faqs.answer: Same as minor passport: Fee ₹1,000, validity 5 years (or until 18). Documents: Baby's birth certificate (MANDATORY), both parents' passports (or Aadhaar if parents don't have passports), marriage certificate of parents, newborn's photo (can be taken at PSK). Both parents must visit PSK with baby for biometric capture (baby's photo). Processing: 30 days.

faqs.question: Tatkal is urgent, but passport still takes 1-7 days. How?
faqs.answer: Because even Tatkal skips detailed police verification (trusted applicant due to strong identity proof provided). PSK + biometrics done same day, police clearance can be parallel or skipped, printing fast-tracked, delivery expedited. But system still needs 1-7 days due to printing and delivery logistics. TRUE emergency (same-day need) may need MEA's special intervention, which is rare.

faqs.question: How much does an Indian passport cost?
faqs.answer: Normal 36-page: Rs 1,500. Normal 60-page (jumbo): Rs 2,000. Tatkal 36-page: Rs 3,500. Tatkal 60-page: Rs 4,000. Minor passport (under 18): Rs 1,000. These fees are paid online during the application process via net banking, credit/debit card, or UPI. No additional charges - don't pay agents.

faqs.question: How long does passport processing take?
faqs.answer: Normal: 15-30 days after PSK visit (including police verification). Tatkal: 1-3 days after PSK visit (police verification happens later). If police verification is delayed, normal processing can take up to 45 days. Track your application status at passportindia.gov.in using the application reference number.

faqs.question: Can I apply for passport without Aadhaar?
faqs.answer: Aadhaar is strongly recommended as it serves as both identity and address proof in one document. However, it's not mandatory - you can apply with other accepted documents (Voter ID + utility bill for address, 10th marksheet for DOB). Without Aadhaar, you may need to carry more documents to the PSK and the verification process may take slightly longer.

faqs.question: What is the passport validity?
faqs.answer: 10 years for adults (18 and above). 5 years for minors (under 18) or until the minor turns 18, whichever is earlier. The passport is valid from the date of issue, not the date of application. You can apply for renewal up to 1 year before expiry - don't wait until the passport expires to renew.

disclaimer: Passport fees, processing times, and procedures as per Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) as of March 2026. MEA may update procedures, documents, or fees. Always check passportindia.gov.in for latest updates before applying.
